_doc: Mass roles shared by every building (loader: forms/roles.rs, struct MassRule). One entry per part label. eave: wall height above the base, one of {"m":[lo,hi]} metres | {"floors":n} lot storeys | {"rel":[lo,hi]} lot storeys plus a drawn offset | {"nave":k} times the monument's nave height | {"width":k} times the mass's short side | {"main":k} times the main body's wall height (absent: the lot's storeys). base: "ground" (default) | "stack" (on top of the mass under it) | {"m":x} | {"main":k}. roof: a kind, "culture", or a draw "a|b" among gable, hip, shed, pyramid, halfhip, gablet, gambrel, mansard, saltbox, flat, cone, dome, barrel, tent. strict: true keeps the rule's pitched roof under a flat-roof tradition (which otherwise flattens ordinary pitched kinds). pitch: degrees | [lo,hi] | {"culture":delta}. axis: long (default) | short | street | main | cross. high (shed): main | street | back. overhang: metres. wall / cover: a material or "culture". openings: none | door. minor: small decorative mass. round: sides of the regular polygon replacing the footprint. tiers: {count:[lo,hi], inset, first, skirt:{rise,overhang}, top}. composable: a long mass may break into parts of different heights. floors: storeys shown by the windows. overrides: {<culture id or monument family>: {<label>: rule}} replace a shared rule for that culture.
